name: awesome-bfcm-2026 (thuongtin)
accepts: Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2026 deals collected from public Reddit threads, GitHub lists, Facebook posts and X, in categories AI & Dev Tools, Software & SaaS, Hosting & Cloud, Electronics, Hardware, Courses, Games, Other. No Mac or iOS section.
how_to_submit: Open an issue or a pull request with the deal name, discount, URL, category, expiry and a source link. The README is generated from a Notion database every six hours, so a README edit is overwritten; the owner closes such pull requests and adds the deal to the database by hand.
entry_format: Columns Deal, Discount, Price, Expires, Source, Notes; generated, not edited by hand.
rules: English only. No affiliate spam and no invented prices.

A pull request that edits the README is closed with 'the README is generated from that database'; the deal may still be added by the owner. An issue is the route that matches how the list is maintained.
status_note: 1,497 deals on 20 Nov 2026. One pull request merged ever (3 Nov 2026); 5 open; 8 closed without a merge, 6 of them because the README is generated. Every recent commit is the owner's sync.
